generation.scope: Every basepointed three-dimensional quartic-center image in the finite regular-domain main component is a rank-three quadric. On each nonexceptional component the vertex polynomial is a power of one cyclic irreducible factor. Rank-four quadrics are excluded even with reducible poles.
